rationale: The run reproduced Figure 2's first-stage and reduced-form regressions (N=722) and the added-variable-plot .gph files exist (gph/mfg_imppw_9007long_2sls1_av.gph, gph/mfg_imppw_9007long_olsred_av.gph). The produced output outputs/figure2_firststage_reducedform.csv reports first_stage coef 0.8151, robust se 0.0918, t 8.882; reduced_form coef -0.3398, se 0.0712, t -4.774 (n=722). These match the authors' shipped Stata log czone_plot_import_long_final.log to high precision: instrument coefficient .8150955/.0917686/8.88 (first stage) and -.3397627/.0711647/-4.77 (reduced form). Every value is within ~2% of the paper's rounded targets (0.82/0.09/8.88 and -0.34/0.07/-4.77), well inside the 5% band, and t-stats and N=722 agree exactly. The only fix applied was installing matplotlib for plotting (severity: minor, no effect on the numerical results). All six components match.
